system.longDesc: Your magic gives you supernatural insight beyond just the mundane senses.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Divination Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Divination Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Divina-tion Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Divination Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Divination Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Divination Arcana spells for –1 SP.
